topics.description: Protests have intensified in Minnesota following the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti by Border Patrol. The incident has sparked outrage and calls for investigation, with many questioning the use of force by immigration authorities.
topics.reason: The shooting of Alex Pretti has become a rallying cry for anti-ICE protests in Minnesota.

topics.description: There are growing concerns about childcare fraud in Minnesota, with a single building linked to $380 million in Medicaid billing. This has raised questions about the oversight and regulation of childcare services in the state.
topics.reason: The large-scale Medicaid billing fraud has sparked concerns about the vulnerability of childcare programs to abuse.
